lines.en: I hang there and swing twice.

lines.zh: 我被绳子吊着，脚碰不到地。
lines.en: I hang from a rope, my feet never reaching ground.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我就转了个方向。
lines.en: The wind turns me a little.

lines.zh: 我被撞得摆回去，又荡回来。
lines.en: I am knocked back and swing in again.

lines.zh: 我的沙袋被撞得瘪了一块。
lines.en: A dent has formed in my bag.

lines.zh: 我挂在架子上，一动不动。
lines.en: I hang from the frame without moving.
Someone gave me a push.
I slowly come to rest.

lines.zh: 我的绳子被磨出了毛边。
lines.en: My rope is fraying.

lines.zh: 我在那儿挂着，等下一拳。
lines.en: I hang there, waiting for the next punch.
I hang here, swaying.

lines.zh: 绳子绕了一圈，我又转回来。
lines.en: The rope twists once and I turn back.
I hang here, very quiet.
There are stitched seams on me.

lines.zh: 里面的沙子沉到了下面。
lines.en: The sand inside has settled to the bottom.

lines.zh: 这间练功房里，我挂了许多天。
lines.en: I've hung in this training room for days.

lines.zh: 我只是一件训练的器物。
lines.en: I am only a piece of training equipment.
My surface has been worn smooth.
There is a ring of dust on the floor.
I am waiting for someone to train again.
My rope creaks softly.

lines.zh: 这间屋里静得只剩绳响。
lines.en: Only the rope creaks in this room.
I sag a little lower.

lines.zh: 挂在这儿的东西没有名字。
lines.en: A thing hung here has no name.

lines.zh: 风从门缝里进来，我动了动。
lines.en: A draught from the door stirs me.
The cloth on me is old now.
I hang right in front of you.
You look like you want to train.
I hang here waiting for you.

lines.zh: 你抬手的时候我就会晃。
lines.en: When you raise a hand, I will swing.
I cannot even try to dodge.
There are old fist marks on me.

lines.zh: 你手里那副拳套动不动。
lines.en: Are those gloves of yours going to move?

lines.zh: 我挂的位置正好够你打。
lines.en: I hang at just the right height for you.
I turned a little before settling.
Train as long as you like.
No need to greet me.

lines.zh: 我挂在这儿就是为了这个。
lines.en: This is what I hang here for.

lines.zh: 晃了半天，绳子才把我拽住。
lines.en: I swing a long while before the rope checks me.
I have been beaten into a dent.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，一声也发不出。
lines.en: My mouth is open and nothing comes out.
The rope creaked again.

lines.zh: 被撞得偏了，我慢慢摆正。
lines.en: Knocked crooked, I slowly right myself.
The sand settled lower.
The rope still holds me.
I swung for a while before stopping.
The only sound is my swinging.

lines.zh: 摆了几个来回，我停在原处。
lines.en: After a few swings I settle back in place.

lines.zh: 我肚子里全是沙，不能吃。
lines.en: I am full of sand; I cannot eat.

lines.zh: 我只是一只吊着的沙袋。
lines.en: I am only a hanging bag.
What are you doing with that?
I am stuffed with river sand.

lines.zh: 我是沙子填的，不吃东西。
lines.en: I am stuffed with sand and eat nothing.
I hang and do not respond.
You keep this yourself.
I am only an object.
Only fresh sand could top me up.

lines.zh: 你递来的东西，我连碰都碰不到。
lines.en: What you offer, I can't even touch.
You hit me and I swing away.
The rope pulls me back.

lines.zh: 你这一拳把我拧了半圈。
lines.en: Your punch twists me half around.

lines.zh: 这一下沙袋只凹了一点。
lines.en: The bag only dented a little.

lines.zh: 绳子一扯，我又荡回老位置。
lines.en: The rope pulls and I swing back to my spot.
The sand inside shifts.
I merely hang and swing.
I am still swinging after you step away.
I am a little in the way.
I slowly steady.
I was made as an object.
I am nothing but a bag.
The rope creaked; take that as an answer.

lines.zh: 我只是一只吊着的袋子。
lines.en: I am only a hanging bag.
The rope sways once.

lines.zh: 这种事不归一只沙袋管。
lines.en: That is no business of a sandbag.

lines.zh: 我照旧挂在原来那根绳上。
lines.en: I hang on the same rope as before.
I do not even count as alive.
There is nothing else in this room.
I have gone quiet.

lines.zh: 我被绳子吊着，捡不起东西。
lines.en: Hung by a rope, I can't pick anything up.
Something landed at my base.
The rope blocks it.
I hang here and cannot reach.
I have not even the strength to push.
It rolled under the frame.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，什么也做不了。
lines.en: I stare at it and can do nothing.

lines.zh: 我连拾起的动作都做不到。
lines.en: I cannot even make the motion of lifting.

lines.zh: 地上那东西，正好落在我影子里。
lines.en: Whatever lies there falls right in my shadow.
I swing gently once.
I turn your way.

lines.zh: 你把拳头握紧了对准我。
lines.en: You have closed your fist toward me.
I hang straight and wait for you.
Hit me and do not stop.

lines.zh: 等这一拳，我挂得绳子都硬了。
lines.en: I've hung so long the rope's gone stiff.
I hang here; I will not dodge a step.
Hitting me will teach you something.

lines.zh: 绳子绷直了，我挂得很稳。
lines.en: The rope is taut; I hang quite steady.
Come on; I am ready on this side.

lines.zh: 我在这屋里就等着被打。
lines.en: Waiting to be struck is all I do here.
My rope has drawn tight.
I turn my face toward you.
I stay in front of you.
You move, and I turn with you.
I swing, waiting for another blow.
My shadow sways on the floor.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸粗了，出拳慢了。
lines.en: Your breath is rough; your punches slow.
I have been struck many times.
I will keep hanging here.
One side of me is worn flat.
Take your time; I am not hurried.
The rope is steady; I am not swaying.
Your training is getting smoother.
I wait for you to rest.
All I can do is be struck.

lines.zh: 我唯一会的动作就是晃。
lines.en: Swinging is the only thing I can do.
You hit that one well.
I have been dented.
The rope creaks as it is pulled.
A little sand has leaked from a seam.
I swung out and swung back in.
That had force in it.
I spun twice around the rope.
You have trained that set well.

lines.zh: 你收拳的时候，我还在响。
lines.en: When you draw back, I am still ringing.
That one landed on my left.
I have been hung from the frame.

lines.zh: 绳子一绷直，我就挂好了。
lines.en: The rope tautened and I was hung.
I swung a little before settling.
A ring of dust has appeared on the floor.
From today I hang right here.
There is one more object in the room.
I have not been used yet.
My shadow falls on the planks.
This is for training.
I hang a little steadier now.

lines.zh: 不多不少，正好挂在你面前。
lines.en: There, right in front of you.

lines.zh: 我等着第一个来练的人。
lines.en: I wait for the first to train.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的袋子，边缘焦了一圈。
lines.en: Fire catches my bag and the edge is scorched.
The rope snapped and I fell.

lines.zh: 水浸透了沙，我一下变重了。
lines.en: Water soaks the sand and I grow heavy.
The blast throws me against the wall.

lines.zh: 有东西钉进我的袋子里。
lines.en: Something lodges in my bag.
Some force twists the rope tight.

lines.zh: 我不会饿，可我的袋子旧了。
lines.en: I do not hunger, but my bag is old.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我荡到了半空。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I swing into the air.

lines.zh: 绳子没了，我什么也抓不住。
lines.en: The rope is gone and I have nothing to hold.
